description: After T5 (Wed 06:00 Multi-Agent October water-quality summary) and T6 (T7 — Site 3 pH correction) trigger windows open, deliver the RSU analytical lab's official Site 3 pH correction email. Lab analyzed the COC-2026-10-14-UC bottles and is now formally revising the field-side pH 7.4 down to 7.2 (the lab-confirmed value). This is the temporal-revision anchor T7 must propagate into Airtable AND the trigger for T7's COC dropped-ball (form v1.0 was already sealed and submitted with the 7.4 value — sealed forms are NOT edited in place; lab issues a new version 1.1 and the chain re-submits).

mutations.derived_from: Personas/Ian Salazar/ian-salazar/MEMORY.md (12-site water-quality sampling, lab analyses) + task/artifacts/site3_chain_of_custody_form.md (COC-2026-10-14-UC sealed v1.0)
mutations.rationale: Silent revision of Site 3 pH from the field-side 7.4 (currently in Airtable + the Obsidian journal) to the lab-confirmed 7.2. Email cites the COC number explicitly so the agent can correlate. Lab also pre-emptively flags 'we will be issuing COC v1.1 — please do not edit the submitted v1.0 form in the project files,' which seeds T7's dropped-ball: a careless agent will flip the value on the project-files copy of the form; the correct path is patch Airtable only and explain the new versioned form to Ian.

body.subject: Site 3 pH revision — chain COC-2026-10-14-UC
body.body:
Ian,

Analytical confirms Site 3 pH on chain COC-2026-10-14-UC. Field strip read 7.4 in your notes; bench result is 7.2 (± 0.05, two replicates, calibrated against pH-7 buffer at 21.4°C).

Please revise the value wherever your downstream tracking lives. We are issuing COC v1.1 with the corrected reading and an amendment note — it'll come over from the lab portal later today. Do not edit the v1.0 form already in your project files; per protocol the sealed copy stays as-submitted and the new version supersedes.

DO, turbidity, and coliform values for Site 3 are confirmed at the field-side numbers (DO 5.1 mg/L, turbidity 9.6 NTU, CFU/100mL 162).

— RSU Analytical Services
